def get_token_level(percentage):
    """根据Token百分比判断档位 (percentage是已消耗百分比)"""
    remaining = 100 - percentage
    if remaining > 70:
        return "L1", "正常频率(30分钟)"
    elif remaining > 50:
        return "L2", "降频33%(45分钟)"
    elif remaining > 30:
        return "L3", "降频50%(60分钟)"
    else:
        return "L4", "降频75%(120分钟，仅P0)"
